points.title: 出生与早年
points.description: 勃朗特姐妹出生于约克郡索尔泰尔。父亲帕特里克·勃朗特是一位爱尔兰牧师，母亲玛丽亚·布兰威尔是一位康沃尔郡女性。1815年，帕特里克被任命为索尔泰尔的副牧师，次年夏洛特在此出生，随后艾米莉和安妮也相继在此出生。这个时期，勃朗特家庭开始展现出对文学和知识的浓厚兴趣，孩子们经常阅读父亲书房中的书籍。
points.descriptionEn: The Bronte sisters were born in Thornton, Yorkshire. Their father, Patrick Bronte, was an Irish clergyman, and their mother, Maria Branwell, was from Cornwall. In 1815, Patrick was appointed as curate in Thornton, and Charlotte was born there the following year, followed by Emily and Anne. During this period, the Bronte family demonstrated a strong interest in literature and knowledge, with the children frequently reading books from their father's library.

points.title: 迁居哈沃斯
points.description: 1820年，勃朗特全家迁至约克郡的哈沃斯，帕特里克被任命为当地圣迈克尔与所有天使教堂的永久牧师。哈沃斯将成为勃朗特姐妹一生的重要居所。在这个偏远的约克郡村庄，姐妹们度过了大部分童年。母亲玛丽亚于1821年去世，留下六个孩子，最大的只有五岁。姨妈伊丽莎白·布兰威尔前来帮忙照顾家庭，成为孩子们生活中重要的女性角色。
points.descriptionEn: In 1820, the Bronte family moved to Haworth in Yorkshire, where Patrick was appointed perpetual curate of St. Michael and All Angels Church. Haworth would become the lifelong home of the Bronte sisters. In this remote Yorkshire village, the sisters spent most of their childhood. Their mother Maria died in 1821, leaving six children, the oldest only five years old. Their aunt Elizabeth Branwell came to help care for the family and became an important female figure in their lives.

points.title: 求学经历
points.description: 1824年，夏洛特和艾米莉被送往考文桥女子学校，这是一所条件艰苦的寄宿学校。次年，她们的两个姐姐玛丽亚和伊丽莎白也进入该校。然而，学校条件恶劣，导致玛丽亚和伊丽莎白感染肺结核并相继去世。这一悲剧对勃朗特姐妹产生了深远影响，特别是夏洛特，她后来在小说《简·爱》中描写了洛伍德学校，就是以考文桥为原型。学校经历也促使姐妹们更加紧密地团结在一起，并在家中创造了自己的文学世界。
points.descriptionEn: In 1824, Charlotte and Emily were sent to Cowan Bridge School, a harsh boarding school. The following year, their two older sisters Maria and Elizabeth also attended. However, the poor conditions led to Maria and Elizabeth contracting tuberculosis and dying shortly after. This tragedy had a profound impact on the Bronte sisters, especially Charlotte, who later depicted Lowood School in 'Jane Eyre' based on Cowan Bridge. The school experience also brought the sisters closer together and led them to create their own literary world at home.

points.title: 重返学校与教学
points.description: 1831年，夏洛特重返罗海德女子学校，这次是作为学生。1835年，她回到该校担任教师，同时艾米莉也短暂就读于此。夏洛特在罗海德期间结识了好友艾伦·纳西和玛丽·泰勒，这些友谊对她后来的文学创作产生了影响。1838年，夏洛特因家庭原因离开罗海德，回到哈沃斯照顾生病的父亲。这一时期，勃朗特姐妹开始尝试写作，创作了大量诗歌和短篇小说，为日后的文学成就奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: In 1831, Charlotte returned to Roe Head School, this time as a student. In 1835, she went back to the school as a teacher, while Emily also attended briefly. During her time at Roe Head, Charlotte befriended Ellen Nussey and Mary Taylor, friendships that would influence her later literary work. In 1838, Charlotte left Roe Head due to family obligations to care for her ailing father. During this period, the Bronte sisters began writing extensively, producing numerous poems and short stories that laid the foundation for their later literary achievements.

points.title: 文学创作高峰
points.description: 1846年，勃朗特姐妹以男性笔名出版了一本诗集，署名为柯勒·贝尔、埃利斯·贝尔和阿克顿·贝尔。1847年，她们的小说作品相继问世：夏洛特的《简·爱》、艾米莉的《呼啸山庄》和安妮的《艾格妮丝·格雷》。这些作品立即获得了成功，尤其是《简·爱》和《呼啸山庄》，被认为是英国文学史上的经典之作。然而，当她们的真名被公开后，评论界对女性作家能够创作如此强有力的作品表示惊讶。这一时期标志着勃朗特姐妹文学创作的巅峰，她们的作品以其深刻的心理描写和对社会规范的挑战而闻名。
points.descriptionEn: In 1846, the Bronte sisters published a collection of poems under male pseudonyms: Currer, Ellis, and Acton Bell. In 1847, their novels were published: Charlotte's 'Jane Eyre', Emily's 'Wuthering Heights', and Anne's 'Agnes Grey'. These works were immediately successful, particularly 'Jane Eyre' and 'Wuthering Heights', which are considered classics of English literature. However, when their true identities were revealed, critics were surprised that women could write such powerful works. This period marked the peak of the Bronte sisters' literary careers, known for their deep psychological insights and challenges to social norms.

points.title: 悲剧与遗产
points.description: 1848年，勃朗特家族遭受一连串打击：艾米莉于12月因肺结核去世，年仅30岁；1849年5月，安妮也因同样的疾病去世，年仅29岁。夏洛特独自继续写作，出版了《雪莉》(1849)和《维莱特》(1853)，并在1854年与父亲的助理牧师亚瑟·贝尔·尼科尔斯结婚。然而，婚后仅一年，夏洛特也于1855年3月因怀孕并发症去世，年仅38岁。勃朗特姐妹虽然生命短暂，但她们的文学作品却产生了深远影响，尤其是《简·爱》和《呼啸山庄》至今仍被广泛阅读和研究，成为英国文学不可或缺的经典。
points.descriptionEn: In 1848, the Bronte family suffered a series of blows: Emily died of tuberculosis in December at age 30; Anne died of the same disease in May 1849 at age 29. Charlotte continued writing alone, publishing 'Shirley' (1849) and 'Villette' (1853), and married her father's curate Arthur Bell Nicholls in 1854. However, just a year later, Charlotte died in March 1855 due to complications of pregnancy at age 38. Though their lives were short, the Bronte sisters' literary works have had a profound impact, with 'Jane Eyre' and 'Wuthering Heights' still widely read and studied today, becoming indispensable classics of English literature.

supporter.zh: 勃朗特姐妹被视为维多利亚时代最杰出的女性作家之一，她们的作品展现了非凡的才华和深刻的洞察力。夏洛特的《简·爱》开创了女性独立意识的先河，艾米莉的《呼啸山庄》以其复杂的叙事结构和深刻的心理描写著称，安妮的作品则真实反映了维多利亚时代的社会现实。她们在男性主导的文学界取得成功，为后来的女性作家开辟了道路，证明了女性同样能够创作出具有永恒价值的文学作品。
supporter.en: The Bronte sisters are regarded as one of the most remarkable female writers of the Victorian era, whose works demonstrate extraordinary talent and profound insight. Charlotte's 'Jane Eyre' pioneered female consciousness, Emily's 'Wuthering Heights' is known for its complex narrative structure and deep psychological portrayal, and Anne's works authentically reflected the social realities of Victorian times. They succeeded in a male-dominated literary world, paving the way for future female writers and proving that women could create works of lasting value.

critic.zh: 批评者指出勃朗特姐妹的作品存在局限性，尤其是对宗教和阶级观念的保守态度。她们的作品虽然挑战了某些社会规范，但仍反映了维多利亚时代的道德观念。此外，勃朗特姐妹的文学成就也受到其短暂生命的限制，未能完全发展其创作潜力。一些评论家认为她们的小说结构不够完美，情节有时过于戏剧化，人物塑造也存在一定的理想化倾向。
critic.en: Critics point out limitations in the Bronte sisters' works, particularly their conservative attitudes toward religion and class concepts. While their works challenged some social norms, they still reflected Victorian moral values. Additionally, their literary achievements were limited by their short lives, preventing them from fully developing their creative potential. Some critics argue their novels have structural imperfections, overly dramatic plots at times, and somewhat idealized character portrayals.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，勃朗特姐妹已成为英国文学的标志性人物。她们的作品被改编成无数电影、电视剧和戏剧，持续影响着当代文化。勃朗特姐妹的生平故事，尤其是她们在偏远约克郡的创作生活，已成为文学传奇的一部分。学术界对她们的研究持续不断，关注她们作品中的女性主义元素、心理深度和叙事创新。勃朗特姐妹不仅因其文学成就被铭记，还因其作为女性在男性主导的社会中取得成功的象征意义而受到推崇。
objective.en: In academic circles and popular culture, the Bronte sisters have become iconic figures in English literature. Their works have been adapted into numerous films, TV series, and plays, continuing to influence contemporary culture. The story of their lives, particularly their creative existence in remote Yorkshire, has become part of literary legend. Academic research on them continues, focusing on feminist elements, psychological depth, and narrative innovation in their works. The Bronte sisters are remembered not only for their literary achievements but also for their symbolic significance as women who succeeded in a male-dominated society.

self.zh: 我越是孤独，越是没有朋友，越是没有支持，我就得越尊重我自己。
self.en: The more solitary, the more friendless, the more unsustained I am, the more I will respect myself.

others.zh: 艾米莉·勃朗特是一位隐藏在云层中的火山，平静的外表下燃烧着炽热的激情。
others.en: Emily Bronte was a volcano hidden behind clouds of snow; the apparent tranquillity of her exterior concealed the glowing fires of her nature.
